What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Shadows Of The Empire]]: left, the image of [[Shadows Of The Empire (Errata)]] (holotable commit 3d4777c); right, the image of [[Shadows Of The Empire (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit a5142dd). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d4777cf1e76188c7c9199075e8e4e87d63bfb94/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/shadowsoftheempire.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/shadowsoftheempire.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
